test_name: Verify user registration with valid data
preconditions: Browser is open and navigated to https://automationexercise.com
test_steps: Step 1: Click on 'Signup / Login' button
Step 2: Enter name 'TestUser' and email address 'testuser@example.com'
Step 3: Click 'Signup' button
Step 4: Fill in account details: Title, Password 'Test@123', Date of Birth
Step 5: Check 'Sign up for our newsletter!' checkbox
Step 6: Fill in Address Information: First name, Last name, Company, Address, Country, State, City, Zipcode, Mobile Number
Step 7: Click 'Create Account' button
Step 8: Verify 'ACCOUNT CREATED!' is visible
Step 9: Click 'Continue' button
Step 10: Verify logged in as 'TestUser'
expected_result: Account is created successfully, user is logged in and 'Logged in as TestUser' is displayed.

test_name: Verify user registration with existing email
preconditions: Browser is open and navigated to https://automationexercise.com. An account with email 'existing@example.com' already exists.

Step 2: Enter name 'NewUser' and email address 'existing@example.com'
Step 3: Click 'Signup' button
Step 4: Observe the error message
expected_result: Error message 'Email Address already exist!' is displayed.
